newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Volker Stevin, Kondor start share swap.
newsitem.headline: Volker Stevin, Kondor start share swap.

text.p: Construction firm Volker Stevin NV said on Monday it had agreed with Dutch sector rival Kondor Wessels to carry out a share exchange as part of a previously-announed merger between the two firms.
"The boards announce... with reference to the merger of Kondor Wessels and Volker Stevin, that the share exchange will be done," the companies said in a joint statement.

The companies said in March they were in talks on a full merger which would be based on an expected share exchange of 2.25 shares of Kondor Wessels group for one share of Volker Stevin and that the deal had effectively been sealed subject to shareholder approval.
As a result of the clinching of the merger with the share exchange, Koninklijke Volker Stevin will change its name from June 6 to Koninklijke Volker Wessels Stevin NV, the companies said.
